title: An enthralling night out in Grandaa
text: This was a wonderful night from start to finish. Molly was the perfect guide in explaining Spanish food culture and lifestyle. The tapas were delicious and varied from savoury to sweet with wine and beer to accompany them. The tapas venues were great too. It would be hard to have had such an experience doing this solo. As if the night could not get any better, it did, the Flamenco was just enthralling. It was in an intimate theatre setting, the artists were super talented and all in all it was a sensory experience which will live long in our memories. We would highly recommend this tour.
author: W6139HBlizm

title: Spanish Evening
text: A good introduction to spanish wines and tapas as served in Spain. Our guide, Molly, was well-versed in spanish history and culture which led to great conversations with her and other group members. The evening concluded with a traditional flamenco show which was thrilling in its authenticity and drama.
author: ANDY44K

title: Excellent walking tapas and Flamenco tour
text:
We were met by our tour guide Molly, English speaking multilingual guide that has move to Grenada some years ago. 
She was very versed on the culture and history.  We had an excellent walking tour of the city me and old. The food and wine was excellent including the personal Flamenco show we had a front row seat. She also recommended best shipping and restaurants to eat at and even scheduled our lady night dining at one of her favorite restaurant Chikito in Grenada.
Thank you so much Molly
Aloha
Steven and JoAnn  Maui Hawaii
author: kealasd

title: A fun evening of wine tapas and flamenco
text: Molly was an excellent guide, she was friendly and informative. The food and wine were delicious and as there were just the two of us she took us to a local wine bar as well. The flamenco performance was captivating and guitarist was fantastic. Would definitely recommend.
author: gillr305

title: Excellent experience, will be bringing family to the show next time.
text: Had a great experience, Molly our guide was full of fantastic information, from our tapas to the history of Granada…even though we chose one of the warmest months, Molly made sure we were in A/C shops and cafes.. we ended the afternoon with a flamenco show which was fantastic, if your thinking about this tour don’t hesitate your love it .
author: neiladams2015

title: Granada tapas and Flamenco evening tour
text: We were fortunate to have a "private" tour for 2 as we were the only guests to arrive. Molly was great. She provided excellent information about the food, wine, culture, history, and Flamenco. Highly recommended tour.
author: Ken M

title: Great Experience in Granada
text: This was a great experience. Our guide Molly blended unique food experience with lots of background on culture and history.  A lol the food tastings were unique to Granada, and most of them were things we were not likely to try on our own.  The food was delicious.  The flamenco was very good.  We highly recommend this tour and our guide Molly.
author: kbpdx

title: A Good Experience to try some tapas & see Flamenco
text:
Katya was very pleasant and also thorough in explaining the tapas we ate and the wine we drank. There was 12 of us in the group. We went to 2 places where we sampled several tapas at each. We also tried 2 olive oils & at least 3 wines. We had a main dish as well. We went to a spice store. Then as I was the only one in the group doing the flamenco show, a different guide, Molly, took me to a place for a glass of cava & a small dessert while she explained the history of the flamenco. The eating part of the type was all quite good.
